summary: Completed Interlude on production database disaster recovery and operational safeguard engineering.
evidence: Analyzed GitLab production database deletion: distinguished cold backup storage from automated continuous restore drills with verified RTO/RPO targets.

Formulated defensive infrastructure guardrails: zero-trust JIT break-glass access, red terminal prompt isolation, WORM immutable backup buckets, Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) WAL archives, and programmatic node role verification (pg_is_in_recovery).
